prototypes.title: Shepherd Maze
prototypes.description: Find your way through a nighttime village. Walk automatically and choose at each junction.

prototypes.title: Shepherd Adventure
prototypes.description: Prepare a lantern, follow clues, and find the quiet shelter beyond the village.
prototypes.image_alt: A shepherd carrying a glowing lantern faces the timber gate and lamplit stone walls of the sleeping market

prototypes.title: Among the Crowd
prototypes.description: Explore a Galilean hillside as Jesus teaches, with timed captions. Compare V1 and V2 characters inside the experience.
prototypes.image_alt: Same player view of Jesus and the crowd: V1 Blender models on the left, V2 free models on the right

prototypes.title: Little Light Library
prototypes.description: Read and listen to three Bible retellings in a child-sized room. Jonah’s 13-page story includes animated paper scenes, narration in nine languages and looping soundtracks that fade between story sections.
prototypes.image_alt: The closed Adam and Eve storybook rests cover-up on the table, with Adam, Eve and a tree toy on the top shelf in the Little Light Library room.

prototypes.title: Story Diorama
prototypes.description: A reusable storytelling component combining illustrated scenes, scrolling text and gentle soundtracks. Watch Noah’s story or explore the playback and layout controls.
prototypes.image_alt: Illustrative painting of Noah beside the wooden framework of the ark, from the Story Diorama demonstration
